newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SWEDEN'S SECURUM TO SELL AKZO STAKE.
newsitem.headline: SWEDEN'S SECURUM TO SELL AKZO STAKE.

text.p: Chemicals group Akzo Nobel NV said on Thursday that Sweden's state-owned Securum AB had explored the possibility of selling its remaining stake in Akzo Nobel.
On behalf of Securum and Akzo Nobel, ABN AMRO Rothschild will market the shares through a bookbuilding procedure.
One of the buyers will be NV Arnhemsche Maatschappij tot het houden van aandelen Akzo Nobel , a bourse-listed investment vehicle whose only activity is holding Akzo Nobel shares.
Last year, Securum sold a stake of about five percent in Akzo Nobel, after which it retained a 13.2 percent interest in the chemicals group.
Akzo Nobel said the sale of Securum's remaining stake was in line with the Swedish company's ongoing disposal programme.
Akzo Nobel said it would support the transaction given the present market conditions and the possibility to resolve the overhang of the shares in a controlled manner.

In a separate statement, investment group Arnhemsche said it had agreed to buy Akzo Nobel shares from Securum. It said it would finance this purchase by issuing new Arnhemsche shares, of which more details would be published later. ABN AMRO Rothschild will be global coordinator of the offering of new Arnhemsche shares. -- Amsterdam newsroom +31 20 504 5000
